listing.name: Descent II (DXX-Rebirth)
listing.summary: Set up Descent II through its upstream dxx-rebirth player using your own original files. Setup, profiles and updates stay upstream-owned.

steps.title: Use this original game and edition
steps.instruction: Use your own retail descent2.hog, descent2.ham, descent2.s22 and all six alien1/alien2/fire/groupa/ice/water PIG files. Optional movies stay optional. The separate documented PC/Mac Descent II demo uses its own complete demo set; Descent I shareware does not supply this game. Keep your originals elsewhere unchanged; upstream handles its own data recognition and preparation. A Portcove registration does not authenticate original-game files.

steps.title: Prepare upstream and select the real player
steps.instruction: Use the upstream Windows DXX-Rebirth-Windows-x86_64 Actions artifact or a complete player prepared with upstream’s supported build instructions. The observed tagged releases do not provide a matching binary asset. Keep the package complete and select d2x-rebirth.exe, with its own player folder as the working directory. Put this game’s data beside that player, or use two argument lines, -hogdir then its full data-folder path. D1X and D2X are separate players; a source archive is not their native executable.

steps.title: Keep the actual original and player data
steps.instruction: Keep separate player/profile copies for Descent and Descent II. Preserve the build’s actual writable directory, player profiles, saves, missions and configuration; custom D1X_REBIRTH_HOME/D2X_REBIRTH_HOME or build choices can change it. Preserve the complete working player folder as well. Upstream describes DOS-save compatibility; no Portcove save conversion or native observation is established.

steps.title: Keep external ownership and deliberate Play
steps.instruction: Finish upstream setup first. Registration saves your selected executable, working directory and literal arguments; Play is a separate explicit action. You and upstream own this external runtime, original files and profile. Registration-only removal preserves them. Managed Update, Backup, Rollback, migration and deletion are not offered for these external files. Preserve a working copy and its data before upstream replacement. Other platforms require their own supported upstream application/native flow.
